attributes.residual: 9 hud_flags sites left in offsetof-on-raw form, with the cause measured and named (see verdict R1-NEGATIVE below). 1 remaining raw base is DoEnemyAction's `s32* e` index arithmetic (e[0x33], e+0x35, e+0x1B), untouched: DoEnemyAction sits at real 2 and its base is the subject of the separate schedule park, so retyping it is a different decision.
attributes.scope: src/game/anim/action.c, four commits, all byte-identical: 736cb6fd0 (19 Player sites: weaphold_node x10, vibe_timer x3, vibe_timer2 x3, grab_flags x2, throw_str x1), 4672e3dd9 (DoPlayerAction `f32* atree` retyped to `animinfo*`, 29 sites incl. atree[6]->frame and atree[10]->animscale), ac141f452 (DoEnemyAction `u8* e70` retyped to `animinfo*`, 3 sites), d20dabb30 (field_956, 1 site).
attributes.verdicts: R1 POSITIVE (52 sites, all NEUTRAL byte-identical): plain field reads/writes and whole-pointer loads off a single object base convert cleanly, INCLUDING the two big base RETYPES - `f32* atree` and `u8* e70` both turned out to be `animinfo*` verbatim (atree[6] == animinfo.frame @0x18, atree[10] == animinfo.animscale @0x28), which is the strongest form of the recipe: the raw base was not a byte-pointer at all, it was a project-header struct nobody had matched to it. GREP THE HEADERS FOR A STRUCT WHOSE SCALAR OFFSETS MATCH THE ARRAY INDICES BEFORE ASSUMING A BASE IS UNTYPED. R1 NEGATIVE (9 sites, hud_flags): converting the 9-site read-modify-write bit-op cluster on one s16 field REGRESSED real 1852 -> 2105 and dropped the instruction count 1765 -> 1764, multiset DIFFERS with target-only +3 addi +2 bne and ours-only -2 beq -1 mr -1 stw. Member form let MWCC fold the displacement into each lha/sth and delete the base materialisations the target actually emits; the target rematerialises an addi per cluster. Left raw. R2 CONFIRMED at cluster granularity: the SINGLE isolated s16 flag site at the same base (field_956 @0x956, two bytes from hud_flags @0x964) converts NEUTRAL. So the hazard is the CLUSTER collapsing onto a shared base, not the field type or the base - a one-site conversion of the same shape is safe and a nine-site one is not, which sharpens R2 from 'site-specific spelling' to 'cluster size is the variable'. R3 NOT ENCOUNTERED: no scalar-declared-really-array field in this TU. R4 NOT REACHED: no family landed in the IDENTICAL-multiset-but-coloring-divergent state, so no named-local reintroduction was needed.
